name: supply-sophie-unanswered-round
narrative: Sophie runs RUTF procurement for the Connect-RUTF program, and 17 days ago she asked six suppliers to quote round 2: half have never answered, despite two reminders, and she forwards whatever does arrive to an AI that records it. Sophie opens the round and reads who answered and who has said nothing, how long each has been silent and when she last chased them. She opens the reminder drafted for Sahel, sends it from her own mailbox, and records the chase from the draft. Sahel finally answers with a quote; Sophie forwards it, and the round's history shows Sahel's email, who sent it and what the AI recorded from it, with the email itself behind a Source email toggle. She finds Northgate's questions waiting on her and answers who will import: we import, under the program's duty waiver, and please state freight to Kano. She opens the comparison and reads what each answer still lacks: only Harmattan's quote can be compared on landed total, Kanem's has not stated how many sachets are in a carton, and Sahel's new quote gives no freight figure, no duty figure and no exchange rate, so its landed cost can't be worked out yet. On the round 1 order with Harmattan, she reads the forwarder's message that the trucks are held at the border on our import permit, finds the advance she paid before any invoice existed, and sees the invoice flagged as above the agreed price. Back on her overview, Sophie reads who is still silent and whose move each thing is.

sophie.intro: Sophie buys RUTF for the Connect-RUTF program; suppliers and the freight forwarder email her, and she forwards what they send to an AI that records it.
sophie.name: Sophie

features.description: Tender page header shows the round's label and that it is open past its deadline.
features.verify: Playwright: /supply/procurement/tenders/<round2>/ shows 'RUTF round 2' and 'deadline passed' with '(3 days ago)'

features.description: Outreach table shows reply day/kind, silence since the ask, and Last chased with the reminder count.
features.verify: Playwright: the Sahel Nutrition Industries row shows 'No reply · 17 days' and its Last chased cell reads '2nd reminder'

features.description: The Outreach heading counts replies of all asked.

scenes.narrative: Sophie asked six suppliers to quote round 2 and only three of the six have replied, though she chased the others twice. She opens the round and reads who answered and who is silent, how long each has been silent, and when she last chased them, and she wants the record to keep telling her the truth: what the answers left out, and whose move it is.
scenes.title: Half the round never answered

features.description: The drafts panel lists a Reminder draft for each of the three silent suppliers.
features.verify: Playwright: #drafts contains 3 drafts labelled 'Reminder', one for Sahel Nutrition Industries

features.description: The outreach reply form's Last chased on field saves last_reminder_on and returns to the tender.
features.verify: Playwright: after saving today's date, the Sahel row's Last chased cell shows today

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the reminder drafted for Sahel, which quotes when she last wrote, sends it from her own mailbox, and records the chase from the draft itself, so the round keeps the day.
scenes.title: She chases Sahel from the drafted reminder

features.description: Between scenes 2 and 3 the AI records Sahel's emailed quote and reply over the labs MCP with source ref, excerpt and sender.
features.verify: Django shell: the program's newest OperationCall rows are quote_record and outreach_update on channel 'mcp' with source_sender 'Amadou Issoufou, Sahel Nutrition Industries'

features.description: A Replies only toggle on the round's history shows just the entries recorded from an email.
features.verify: Playwright: after clicking [data-testid=history-replies-only], no 'Last chased' bookkeeping line is visible and Sahel's email event is first

features.description: Each email event shows the sender, the AI recorder and the excerpt behind one Source email toggle.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's email event, opened, shows 'Amadou Issoufou, Sahel Nutrition Industries' and an excerpt containing 'EUR 0.31 per sachet'

scenes.narrative: Sahel answers the reminder with a quote and Sophie forwards it to the AI. The round's history shows Sahel's email, who sent it and what the AI recorded from it; the email's own excerpt sits behind its Source email toggle, so she can check the record against what Sahel wrote.
scenes.title: Sahel finally answers, and the record moves

features.description: The What we owe them section lists Northgate's open questions with raised day and text.
features.verify: Playwright: #owed shows 3 rows under 'Northgate Commodities', each reading '· asked' and the day Northgate asked

features.description: Mark answered opens the commitment resolve form; submitting records the answer and resolved day.
features.verify: Playwright: after submit, the importer question carries an 'Answered' chip and its answer line reads 'Answered <day> by Sophie: We import, under the program's duty waiver; please state freight to Kano.'

scenes.narrative: Sophie reads Northgate's three questions, recorded as answers she owes, and answers the one about who will import on the spot: we import, under the program's duty waiver, and please state freight to Kano.
scenes.title: Northgate is waiting on her, and she answers

features.description: The comparison page compares Harmattan's quote on landed total and names what blocks the others: sachets per carton on Kanem's; the exchange rate, the freight amount and the duties amount on Sahel's.
features.verify: Playwright: /compare/ reads '1 of 3 quotes can be compared on landed total'; Harmattan Therapeutics is under Comparable with a landed total; the Kanem Foods Ltd card shows 'Blocking: Sachets per carton not stated on the quote'; the Sahel Nutrition Industries card shows 'Quote is in EUR and no exchange rate was recorded', 'Freight excluded from the quote but no freight amount recorded' and 'Duties excluded from the quote but no duties amount recorded', and no quantity mismatch

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the comparison and reads what each answer still lacks: only Harmattan's quote can be compared on landed total, Kanem's has not stated how many sachets are in a carton, and Sahel's new quote gives no freight figure, no duty figure and no exchange rate, so its landed cost can't be worked out yet.
scenes.title: An answer is not yet a quote she can use

features.description: Order page shows a Waiting on us banner naming the owed import permit when a shipment requires it and it is not on file.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=waiting-on-us] contains 'import permit' and the page has no 'past the promised lead time' banner

features.description: The order timeline names Crescent Freight & Clearing as the sender of the status change, from source.sender.
features.verify: Playwright: order #history shows 'from Crescent Freight & Clearing'

features.description: The order's invoice table shows the advance paid before any invoice as its own Advance paid row, with the day paid, the amount, and the invoice that later applied it.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=advance-row] contains 'Advance paid', 'USD 53,400.00' and 'applied to INV-HT-26-0912'

features.description: Order page banner lists each invoice line above the contract with billed vs agreed.

scenes.narrative: On the round 1 order with Harmattan, Sophie reads in the order's history the message from Crescent Freight & Clearing that the trucks are held at the border on our import permit, so the next move is hers; she finds the advance she paid at the award, before any invoice existed, as its own row in the invoices, and Harmattan's invoice flagged as above the agreed price.
scenes.title: Round 1's order: waiting on us, paid early, billed high

features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=standing-table] round 2 row contains 'No reply', 'Lagoon Nutripharm' and 'Savanna Ready Foods', and 'answers to Northgate Commodities'

scenes.narrative: Back on her overview, Sophie reads who is still silent and whose move each thing is: round 2 waiting on two suppliers who have not replied and on her answers to Northgate, the order waiting on her permit.
scenes.title: Who is silent, and whose move each thing is
